a.lede: In an interview with TechCrunch, Al Gore suggested he isn't losing sleep over AI data center emissions — he's more worried about the AI industry's own warnings about where the technology is headed.
a.title: Al Gore has a surprisingly calm take on the AI data center backlash

b.title: What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it?
